ConnectionEvent.description:
``event: connection`` -- the job's connection now (M17 plan §4): at the start of a stream
when it is not ``active``, then on every change of its status, e.g. to ``reauth_required``
when the source refused its credentials (the job pauses; ADR 0016 A6) and back to ``active``
once re-authorized.
ConnectionEvent.title: ConnectionEvent

EndEvent.description: ``event: end`` -- the last event of a stream, then the server closes it.
EndEvent.title: EndEvent

ReauthDeadlineIn.description: ADR 0016 A6, A2.2: 24 hours .. 90 days; outside is refused (422), never clamped.
ReauthDeadlineIn.title: ReauthDeadlineIn

ResetEvent.description:
``event: reset`` -- the units since ``Last-Event-ID`` are NOT replayed: reload the job and
its units from the list endpoints, then keep reading (the snapshot and live events follow).
ResetEvent.title: ResetEvent

ThreadParentPolicy.description:
What to collect for thread replies that are INSIDE the date range while their parent is OUTSIDE.

PROPOSED default, pending product-owner confirmation (docs/adr/0011): include the parent and the
full thread, with everything outside the range marked out-of-range (context, not responsive scope).
ThreadParentPolicy.title: ThreadParentPolicy

UnitsEvent.description:
``event: units`` -- units the chain recorded as settled (reconciled or failed), in chain
order, at most ``MAX_UNITS`` per event.
UnitsEvent.title: UnitsEvent

post.description:
ADR 0016 A6: a job paused for re-authorization finishes WITHOUT waiting for its deadline:
every unit not yet reconciled closes ``access_lost`` with the pause's reason class (each in
the job's chain), then the job finalizes (``completed_with_gaps``). Decided here (the pause's
end and ``job_pause_ended`` in the chain, the audit with ``authenticated_at``, one
transaction); carried out by the maintenance worker, started at once (and by its schedule
after any interruption). The answer is the job as it is now: still paused, decided.
